consumer.use: Decide whether the corrected Outcome-Bound sampling-unit semantics eliminate the zero-versus-one slot ambiguity without activating a natural pilot.

decision_target.question: Does constructing and ordinaling every fully provable post-A candidate_identity_birth before naturalness/self-interference guarantee that an interfered birth consumes exactly one fixed slot while contributing zero natural evidence?

intervention.name: slot-before-gates sampling semantics
intervention.description: Construct immutable birth slots solely from canonical identity, authoritative event order, activation boundary and complete birth proof; only afterward gate naturalness and experiment interference.

control_condition.description: Frozen T035 author head 5a73d1ceb130155988863b2695062fa62b565c76, where exact-head review found that section 4 could yield zero units for an interfered birth while section 7 required one consumed fixed ordinal.

treatment_condition.description: Exactly R01-R09 in sampling-unit-cases.md, including a post-A experiment-influenced birth whose fixed expected result is one assigned and consumed slot, zero accepted natural evidence and fail-closed rejection.

measurement.method: Freeze one author commit containing method.md, sampling-unit-cases.md, manifest.yml and registration.v2.json while every counter-hypothesis assessment is pending/not_checked. Then require an independent reviewer to inspect that exact commit and attempt all six counter-review attacks. No natural candidate is observed and no pilot is activated.
measurement.success: The exact-head reviewer finds no protocol-conforming zero-versus-one reading for the interfered birth, cannot renumber around it, cannot apply naturalness during slot construction, cannot soften incomplete birth proof into a skip, and confirms that no favorable review/result label existed at the frozen author head.
measurement.falsification: Any material escape on the six required attacks or any premature favorable assessment/result label rejects this revision without repairing the frozen author files.

cost_metric.method: Record reviewer runtime as descriptive overhead only.

comparison.unit: three frozen T035 defects versus one frozen R01-R09 adversarial case
comparability_constraints: T035 frozen author head and U01-U09 remain unchanged negative evidence
canonical candidate identity and authoritative event-id ordering remain unchanged
the activation boundary A and sample target N are not chosen here
no natural candidate is observed or consumed
review is bound to the exact frozen author commit
confounders: paper agreement cannot establish live event-journal completeness
one independent reviewer may still share conceptual priors with the author
slot precision does not establish Outcome Case efficacy, prevalence or cost

allowed: frozen T035 author revision and terminal rejection
future completeness-reporting Bureau event-journal receipt only for later activation

reviewed_exception.rationale: The successor is paper/adversarial-only, corrects one falsified semantics seam and grants no pilot or productive authority.
